title: Man. Post. Cap. X: PLAC — major denied: innate habitual reatus is a third head
pass_a_gloss: Placeus: you already saw the major can fall. Besides own actual reatus and the Adam-act imputation you labor to prove, there is reatus from own innate—habitual—sin.
pass_b_english: You yourself have seen that the major can be denied: for besides the reatus from one’s own actual sin, and the one you try in vain to prove from Adam’s actual sin imputed, there is a reatus from one’s own innate sin—and, so to speak, habitual.
source_text: Tu ipse vidisti negari posse maiorem: nam praeter reatum ex proprio peccato actuali, & quem frustra probare conaris ex peccato actuali Adae imputato, est reatus ex proprio peccato innato, & ut ita loquar, habituali.
notes: Cap. X Rom. 5:14 densify section 709 from locked 1661 Latin (pp. 370–372 tip, Rom. 5:14).
